integrity: The prior classification of ten induced four-edge-matchings as octahedral carriers is credited; originality is limited to the geodesic-transversal polynomial, remaining minimal sets, and sharp relocation structure. Two standalone executable finite checkers accompany a spectral proof.
limitations: Exact finite statement only for the sixteen-vertex five-regular Clebsch graph; budgeted one-vertex addition/deletion, not token slide, with no independent scholarly validation or exhaustive publication-priority clearance.
title: Clebsch geodesic transversals: the complete census and a sharp four-position relocation threshold
